institutions.name: Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland

requirement.applicantContext: Irish and EU school leavers as classified by RCSI for fees and applications using nationality and residency. Local points govern selection.
requirement.subjectNotes: Present three HL subjects at grade 5 or above and three SL subjects at 4 or above. For six-year entry, include English, mathematics, a laboratory science and a second language. Five-year entry requires HL chemistry and either HL physics or HL biology at 5 or above.
requirement.conditions: Meet the single-sitting 480 Irish-equivalent-point threshold and sit HPAT-Ireland for the year of admission. An HL mathematics bonus can affect the conversion. Previous intake figures appear separately in the 2026 admissions guide.

requirement.applicantContext: Irish and EU school leavers as classified by RCSI for fees and applications using nationality and residency. Local points govern selection.
requirement.subjectNotes: Present three HL subjects at grade 5 or above and three SL subjects at 4 or above. Include English, mathematics, a second language and another subject, plus HL chemistry and either HL biology or HL physics at grade 5 or above.
requirement.conditions: RCSI ranks eligible applicants using Irish Leaving Certificate equivalent points. An HL mathematics bonus can affect the conversion. Previous intake figures appear separately in the 2026 admissions guide.
